precision_recall_curve.definition: PR curve plotting precision vs recall at varying thresholds

roc_curve.definition: ROC curve plotting TPR vs FPR at varying thresholds

average_precision.definition: Area under the PR curve using trapezoidal approximation

base_position_effect.definition: Mean current signal for each nucleotide at each k-mer position
base_position_effect.fidelity: full - computed from raw pore model data

substitution_profile.definition: Mean current shift when substituting central base in each k-mer
substitution_profile.fidelity: full - computed for all valid substitutions

cross_chemistry_correlation.definition: Pearson correlation between r9.4.1 6-mer means and r10.4.1 central 6-mer means

sensitivity_at_precision.definition: Maximum recall achievable at or above a given precision threshold
